name: Seraph interceptor
role: Earth's interceptor drone: fast, fragile, in packs (design section 7). Flies and fights on the GTF Ulysses' numbers until it is tuned.

topSpeed.source: FS2 retail ships.tbl (Root_fs2.vp, sha256 60266906...315ca), field $Max Velocity (z)

reverseSpeed.source: FS2 retail ships.tbl (Root_fs2.vp, sha256 60266906...315ca), field $Rear Velocity; fighters and bombers never reverse

rotationTime.source: FS2 retail ships.tbl (Root_fs2.vp, sha256 60266906...315ca), field $Rotation time

forwardAccel.source: FS2 retail ships.tbl (Root_fs2.vp, sha256 60266906...315ca), field $Forward accel

forwardDecel.source: FS2 retail ships.tbl (Root_fs2.vp, sha256 60266906...315ca), field $Forward decel

afterburnerSpeed.source: ours (AI round 3, after the user's boost override on the player's fighter, 235 m/s): Earth's interceptor is the one Earth fighter built to run a diaspora fighter down, so its burner is 3 x its cruise instead of FS2's 2.1 x (GTF Ulysses +Aburn Max Vel (z) = 150, FS2 retail ships.tbl, Root_fs2.vp, sha256 60266906...315ca). Still 25 m/s short of the player's boost: a player who burns away gains on it, slowly, and loses the gain when the tank runs dry. Earth's fighter, heavy and bomber keep FS2's numbers

afterburnerAccel.source: ours (same note): a quicker ramp than FS2's 0.7 s (GTF Ulysses +Aburn For accel) so the interceptor answers a boost in about the time the player's 0.4 s ramp takes

afterburnerFuel.source: FS2 retail ships.tbl (Root_fs2.vp, sha256 60266906...315ca), field +Aburn Fuel

afterburnerRechargeRate.source: FS2 retail ships.tbl (Root_fs2.vp, sha256 60266906...315ca), field +Aburn Rec Rate

mass.source: Estimate (FS2 takes mass from the 3D model, not ships.tbl); only scales how hard knocks shove the ship

size.source: Estimate of the hull's width, height, length; used for knock spin (box inertia) and the targeting radius
